key.name: icon-size
key.description: Size of dock icons in pixels.

key.name: running-dot-theme-color
key.summary: Use theme color for running dot
key.description: If true, the running dot uses the system theme foreground color. Otherwise, uses the default dock color.

key.name: running-indicator-style
key.description: How running applications are marked: "dot" for a single dot, "dots" for one dot per open window (macOS style), "bar" for a horizontal bar.

key.name: dock-theme
key.description: Glass tint of the dock: "light" for translucent white glass, "dark" for translucent dark glass. Running indicators, badges and tooltips follow the chosen theme.

key.name: click-to-minimize
key.description: If true, clicking the icon of the focused application minimizes its windows instead of only raising them. With several windows open, the click first cycles through the ones still visible and only minimizes when there is nothing left to raise.

key.name: show-apps-button
key.description: If true, the app grid launcher is displayed at the end of the dock. When it is hidden and no other item is present, the dock stays out of the way entirely.

key.name: apps-launcher-enabled
key.description: If true, the Applications button opens the extension's own full-screen app grid, with search and paging, instead of the GNOME overview. If false, the button falls back to the previous behaviour and simply opens the overview's application view.

key.name: apps-launcher-columns
key.summary: Apps per row in the launcher
key.description: Number of applications shown side by side on each row of the launcher grid. Fewer columns mean larger, more spaced out cells and more pages; more columns fit more applications on a single page. Only used when the built-in apps launcher is enabled.

key.name: window-animations-enabled
key.description: If true, windows animate open from their dock icon and fly back to it on minimize, like the macOS Dock. If false, windows use the system's default animations.

key.name: hide-in-fullscreen
key.summary: Stay out of the way in fullscreen
key.description: If true, the dock — including its hot edge at the bottom of the screen — is fully disabled while a window is fullscreen on the primary monitor: games, video players, browsers in F11. Maximized windows are not affected; only windows that actually asked the compositor for the whole monitor.

key.name: show-recent-apps
key.description: If true, the last opened applications that are neither pinned nor currently running are shown in their own section, just before the Applications button and separated from the other icons by a thin divider.

key.name: magnification-enabled
key.description: If true, dock icons grow as the pointer approaches them and push their neighbours aside, like the macOS Dock.

key.name: magnification-scale
key.description: How much bigger the icon directly under the pointer becomes, as a multiplier of its normal size. Only used when magnification is enabled.

key.name: magnification-falloff
key.description: Horizontal distance in pixels, measured from the pointer, beyond which icons keep their normal size. Larger values magnify more icons at once, with a gentler slope. Only used when magnification is enabled.

key.name: recent-apps
key.description: Internal history of recently opened application ids, most recent first. Written by the dock whenever an application starts running; not meant to be edited by hand.

key.name: dock-items
key.description: Ordered list of typed dock item ids, each formatted as "type:value" (for example "app:firefox.desktop" or "folder:/home/user/Downloads").

key.name: dock-groups
key.description: JSON object mapping a group id to its definition, in the form { "groupId": { "name": string, "apps": [string] } }. Stored as JSON because nested dictionaries in GSettings are awkward to manipulate from both the shell and the preferences process.

key.name: launcher-layout
key.description: Internal ordered list of the launcher's top level items, each formatted as "type:value" (for example "app:firefox.desktop" or "folder:0d7f1b2c-..."). It is the arrangement the user made by dragging icons around, so the grid is no longer alphabetical; not meant to be edited by hand.

key.name: launcher-folders
key.description: JSON object mapping a folder id to its definition, in the form { "uuid": { "name": string, "apps": [string] } }. The keys are the bare uuids: the "folder:" prefix only exists in launcher-layout, where folder ids share a list with items of other types. Stored as JSON because nested dictionaries in GSettings are awkward to manipulate; not meant to be edited by hand.

key.name: dock-items-migrated
key.description: Set to true once the legacy pinned-apps.ini file has been imported into dock-items. Never reset it: an empty dock-items list is a valid user choice, not a sign that migration is pending.
